public_domain_references.asv: Be sober, be watchful: your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
public_domain_references.kjv: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

pob.text: Resist him[a], firm in the faith[c][b], knowing that the same sufferings are being experienced by your brotherhood in the world.

spob.text: Resist him. Remain firm in the faith, knowing that your family of believers throughout the world is going through the same kinds of suffering.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.
public_domain_references.web: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
public_domain_references.asv: whom withstand stedfast in your faith, knowing that the same sufferings are accomplished in your brethren who are in the world.
public_domain_references.kjv: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

pob.text: And the God of all grace, who called you into his eternal glory in Messiah, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore, establish, strengthen, and ground you.

spob.text: After you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace will personally restore you, make you firm, strengthen you, and set you on a firm foundation. He is the one who called you into his eternal glory in Messiah[a].

public_domain_references.bsb: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
public_domain_references.web: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
public_domain_references.asv: And the God of all grace, who called you unto his eternal glory in Christ, after that ye have suffered a little while, shall himself perfect, establish, strengthen you.
public_domain_references.kjv: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle [you].

pob.text: To him be the dominion forever and ever[a]. Amen.

spob.text: Ruling power belongs to him forever and ever. Amen.

public_domain_references.bsb: To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.
public_domain_references.web: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
public_domain_references.asv: To him [be] the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
public_domain_references.kjv: To him [be] glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

pob.text: Through Silvanus[a], the faithful brother, as I regard him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God[b]. Stand firm in it.

spob.text: I have written briefly to you through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother. I urge you and solemnly testify that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
public_domain_references.web: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
public_domain_references.asv: By Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I account [him], I have written unto you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God: stand ye fast therein.
public_domain_references.kjv: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.

pob.text: She who is in Babylon[a], chosen together with you, greets you, and so does Mark[c][b], my son.

spob.text: She who is in Babylon[a][b] and was chosen together with you sends you greetings. Mark, my son,[c] also sends you greetings.

public_domain_references.bsb: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.
public_domain_references.web: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
public_domain_references.asv: She that is in Babylon, elect together with [you], saluteth you; and [so doth] Mark my son.
public_domain_references.kjv: The [church that is] at Babylon, elected together with [you], saluteth you; and [so doth] Marcus my son.

pob.text: Greet one another with a kiss of love[a]. Peace to all of you who are in Messiah.

spob.text: Greet one another with a loving kiss. Peace to all of you who are united with Messiah.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
public_domain_references.web: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
public_domain_references.asv: Salute one another with a kiss of love. Peace be unto you all that are in Christ.
public_domain_references.kjv: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace [be] with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
